executive_assessment.text: Subnational depth includes historical county loss records, southern Lika/Dalmatia precipitation projections, Slavonian agricultural sensitivity, and Zagreb/Rijeka flood exposure; different vintages and denominators are retained.

County indicators distinguish age, disability and low income, while readiness measures describe organizations and plans rather than demonstrated response outcomes. No observed climate-conflict pathway is inferred from national security framing.

known_gaps.text: Automated machine-screening is not independent source verification. Routine/default app-use approval does not certify claims or sources. 11 of 11 evidence records and 0 of 0 pathways lack claim-level verification in this remediation; review the linked records before relying on them.
HRV is absent from EXISTING_COUNTRIES.json and no countries/HRV baseline directory was present, so there was no prior Croatia dossier to extend.

The 2020 strategy provides an explicit general security/migration framing, but inspected primary sources did not establish a Croatia-specific climate-to-violent-conflict case or show conflict disrupting adaptation.
County loss totals combine hazards and are not climate-attributed; county vulnerability indices use aggregate indicators rather than household-level disaggregation.
The Commission's 2023 adaptation-progress assessment was inspected but is not allocated as a source or claim here because its shared regional URL budget is used by another country record.
The official 2024 Biennial Transparency Report PDF could not be inspected because of reader-size limits; its metadata/search listing was not used to support claims.
No source-supported Croatian mediated climate-to-violence or reverse FCV-to-climate pathway was established in this review. Strategic migration/security framing is not a documented country pathway.
